about.heading: A specialist shop, not a marketplace
about.body: ELECTRONICS SELLING started as a two-person repair bench and grew into a retail showroom. We stock a deliberately narrow range: the models we would buy ourselves, tested on the bench before they reach the shelf. Every order is checked, photographed and packed by our team, and every warranty claim is handled in-house rather than forwarded to a distant distributor.
list: Every unit bench-tested and charged before dispatch

Transparent pricing — no surprise fees at checkout
Real support over WhatsApp, phone and email
